summary_en: 500,000 shares (2.7% of shares outstanding), ¥300M upper limit, open-market acquisition, Aug 12 2026–Feb 10 2027. Objective: shareholder returns, flexible capital policy, incentive plan diversification.
title_en: Notice of Determination of Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: Cross Marketing Group Inc. announced on August 10, 2026, that its board of directors has authorized the acquisition of up to 500,000 treasury shares (2.7% of shares outstanding) with an upper limit of ¥300 million. The acquisition will be executed via open-market purchases between August 12, 2026, and February 10, 2027. The company stated the purpose is to implement shareholder returns, enable flexible capital allocation, and diversify its incentive plan offerings. As of June 30, 2026, the company held 1,217,201 treasury shares against 19,970,464 issued shares (including treasury). The acquisition is authorized under Article 156 of the Companies Act as applied via Article 165(3).
